authorization.statement: stop with all the stops and make this happen.
authorization.prior_statement: you can have all the approvals for this project
authorization.scope: read-only complete native population census, source checksums, source/cache reconciliation, internal derived cohort metadata; no model training or publication
authorization.separate_receipt_requirement: superseded by direct user instruction in current chat
authorization.review_findings: No scientific finding converted to PASS; native meanings retained and limitations reported.

native_event_key: integer id preserved; decimal-string crosswalk follows upstream documented builder
native_observation_date: native date field retained; only exact calendar dates or midnight bins supported
native_daily_value: dy_ar_km2 retained unchanged; no calibration or missing-value imputation

cache_fields.fire_id: documented decimal string of native id
cache_fields.timestamp: native date comparison only, not operational availability
cache_fields.ring_area_km2: exact numeric hashes match native daily field on every overlap
cache_fields.cumulative_area_km2: finite/nonnegative count only; no scientific interchangeability with native catalog totals

native_order: read-only SQLite ORDER BY id,date,fid, temp_store MEMORY with256MiB SQLite heap cap
cache_order: streamed grouped fire IDs, within-fire date sort; reappearing IDs fail on unique fire metadata key
source_refs: native fid or cache row offset; full-container checksum in census provenance; per-fire/run evidence hashes
duplicates: all copies of duplicate native dates excluded from supported runs; duplicates remain counted
missingness: no gap filling, interpolation or zero substitution
source_value_storage: daily values only in bounded memory; derived persistent products contain cohort metadata, source references and hashes
quality: unknown native measurement QA and uncertainty
